physicalNotes: No radius or mass of M25 is recorded: it is an extended star cluster, and its package frames it at 13.9 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), Hunt & Reffert's tidal radius estimate, a presentation value.

sources.position: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), IC_4725: RA_ICRS 277.94248509, DE_ICRS -19.13084298, the densest point of its members (epoch 2016.0) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.distance: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), IC_4725: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 644.93549011 pc (16th to 84th percentile 644 to 645) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Table 3, IC_4725: mean Gaia DR3 radial velocity 2.01537497 km/s of 218 members (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
